comment_structure_height: Only structures whose bounding box bottom (minY) is inside this range are processed.
comment_floating: Automatic detection of flying structures (airships, planes) and ships at sea: a structure is skipped when at least 'Floating column ratio' of its footprint has more than 'Floating air gap' blocks of air below it, or when 'Water column ratio' of its footprint stands on water. A jigsaw structure placed at an absolute height (no project_start_to_heightmap) counts as an extra hint; optionally terrain_adaptation=none does too.
comment_shaping: Terrain shaping happens before the terrain is generated, so it goes through the vanilla surface rules. Around every processed structure the ground is brought to the row its pieces rest on, raised where the terrain is lower and cleared where it is higher. Seen from above, the shaped area is an irregular circle (a rounded oval for elongated pieces) through the corners of the structure, plus 'Flat margin' plus a blend radius per direction, never less: 'Blend radius', plus 'Blend radius per block of height' for every block of height difference between the structure and the natural terrain in that direction, up to 'Max blend radius'. 'Flat margin' is how many blocks next to the pieces stay flat at their level; the slope fills the whole rest of the circle, carries the natural hills and dips along and meets the untouched terrain at the edge. These sizes are scaled with the structure: the blend radii and 'Shape extra width' by 0.55 for a car-sized structure up to 0.9 for large ones, 'Flat margin' by 0.5 for a car-sized structure up to 1 for large ones. Near the vanilla limit of 8 chunks from the structure start, the slope is shortened, not cut.
comment_irregularity: Shape irregularity (0-1) makes the outline of the shaped terrain irregular. It is still a circle (a rounded oval for elongated pieces) through the structure corners plus 'Flat margin' plus the blend radius of each direction, never less; depending on direction the slope reaches further, by up to 60% of the blend radius times the irregularity plus 'Shape extra width' blocks, so it is long and gentle and fills the whole circle. The flat plateau next to the structure stays about 'Flat margin' wide. Near the vanilla limit of 8 chunks from the structure start, the slope is shortened, not cut. 0 keeps a regular outline.
comment_shell: Shell settings format: "modid:structure_file": { radius, verticalOffset, exponentialSpeed }
comment_lists: Id lists support: full id (modid:name), namespace.*, *, #modid:tag. Structure blacklist: never processed. Foundation blacklist: template files (.nbt) of pieces (classic and jigsaw) that never get a foundation: the terrain is still cleared around them but never raised under them. Force list: always processed, ignoring the blacklist and the automatic floating/water/underground detection.
comment_templates: The list of structure template files known to the server is written to structure_generation_improver.templates.txt at every start.
